heading: Rest and recuperation absence: certain members undergoing extended deployment to a combat zone

tree.heading: Rest and Recuperation Authorized.—
tree.text: Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary concerned may provide a member of the armed forces described in subsection (b) the benefits described in subsection (c).

tree.heading: Covered Members.—
tree.text: A member of the armed forces described in this subsection is any member who—

children.text: is assigned or deployed for at least 270 days in an area or location—
that is designated by the President as a combat zone; and
in which hardship duty pay is authorized to be paid under section 305 or 352(a) of title 37; and
meets such other criteria as the Secretary of Defense may prescribe in the regulations required by subsection (a).

tree.heading: Benefits.—
tree.text: The benefits described in this subsection are the following:

children.text: A period of rest and recuperation absence for not more than 15 days.
Round-trip transportation at Government expense from the area or location in which the member is serving in connection with the exercise of the period of rest and recuperation.

tree.heading: Construction With Other Leave.—
tree.text: Any benefits provided a member under this section are in addition to any other leave or absence to which the member may be entitled.
